conviction_note: Scale is the 12.97% event-implied move (history median 9.74%, verified as real 8-K 2.02 quarterly releases), p_up 47 because the put skew (+30.7 vol pts), 2-of-7 up history and the name's habit of selling prints without a new AI lease outweigh a mechanically large BTC mark-to-market gain, a likely modest revenue beat and an oversold, ~15%-short tape; the findings sum to +0.1 and the scaled number to -0.8, which is small disagreement driven by the asymmetric lease line: the most likely case (no new lease) sells, the less likely case (a new lease) moves +20-35%.

findings.finding: Bitcoin rose ~42.7% in Q3 2026 (CoinGlass via Forklog; Sep 30 close ~$83.5-83.7k from ~$58.5-60k), after Q2's ~12-14% decline produced $138.6M of mostly unrealized digital-asset losses and a $177.1M net loss; at Hut 8's fair-value accounting (Hut 8 reserve plus consolidated ~64% ABTC stake, ABTC 8,002 BTC at 6/30) Q3 should carry several hundred million dollars of unrealized gains and a GAAP profit against a consensus LOSS of -$1.25 to -$1.41 per share, a headline EPS 'beat' that is below operating income and computable by anyone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2025 posted $137.5M net income on BTC marks (https://www.fool.com/data-news/2025/08/07/hut-8-hut-q2-net-income-jumps-to-137m) and the stock moved -3.24% (baseline 2025-08-07); Q2 2026's $138.6M mark loss went with -9.74% but alongside a revenue miss. The mark has not driven reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: The BTC price is public so the gain itself is priced by anyone who models it; what may not be priced is the headline EPS screen: estimate sources still show a -$1.25 to -$1.41 loss, which would read as a very large 'beat' on wires and algos at 07:00 ET. If the market had absorbed it, the consensus would show a profit.
findings.independence: Q2 mark-loss magnitude from The Block https://theblock.co/post/410581/hut-8-shares-slip-mild-q2-revenue-miss-ai-data-center-pipeline-grows (2026-08-04); ABTC holdings from https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ABTC/10-q-american-bitcoin-corp-quarterly-earnings-report-f99ecb52147d.html. Same underlying fact (BTC price), different documents.

findings.finding: Revenue bar is $72.5-74.1M against Q2 2026 actual $74.9M (which missed ~$80M by ~7%, the third straight revenue miss); Q3's average BTC price ran well above Q2's (quarter opened ~$58.5-60k and closed ~$83.5k after Q2 fell ~12%), which lifts consolidated ABTC mining revenue, so a bar set at or below Q2's actual looks beatable by a few percent, though hashprice/difficulty and Compute-segment mix are unverified.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 beat revenue by +31% ($83.5M vs $63.5M, https://finviz.com/news/216975/hut-8-hut-reports-q3-earnings-what-key-metrics-have-to-say) and the stock fell -12.53% because no River Bend tenant was confirmed; Q2 2026 missed by ~7% and fell -9.74%. Revenue beats have been sold; misses hurt.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits below last quarter's actual despite a much higher Q3 BTC price, i.e. it embeds the miss streak rather than the BTC tailwind. If priced, estimates would sit above $75M. Capped small because the bar is not a company guide and mining economics are a proxy.
findings.independence: Q3 BTC path from https://www.simplemining.io/insights/post/bitcoin-market-report-september-2026 and https://news.bitcoin.com/market-updates/bitcoin-price-gains-44-for-second-best-q3-as-ethereum-jumps-71 (proxy, not company revenue). findings.finding: The stock trades on new AI-lease announcements made with the print, and none is visible: EDGAR shows no 8-K after the 2026-09-28 revolver (last lease 8-K 2026-07-20, Beacon Point phase 2), while management had 11 sites under exclusivity averaging >650 MW and an 8.7 GW pipeline at the Aug 4 print; prints without a new tenant have sold (-12.53% Nov 2025, -6.57% Feb 2026, -9.74% Aug 2026) and the one with a lease rose +35.31% (May 2026, Beacon Point $9.8B).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025: record results, no River Bend tenant confirmed, -12.53%. May 2026: Q1 with first Beacon Point lease, +35.31% (https://www.theblock.co/post/400206/hut-8-shares-30-pre-market-9-8-billion-ai-data-center-deal-nvidia-specs). Aug 2026: pipeline update only, -9.74%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the -30% 20-day run-up and +30.7 put skew already lean against it. What the market cannot see is whether a lease drops at 07:00; the absence of any October 8-K and of any lease rumour means the base case is a pipeline-only update, which this name has sold three times out of three. Shrunk for ~15% of shares short and an oversold tape.
findings.independence: Pipeline/exclusivity detail from The Block 2026-08-04 https://theblock.co/post/410581/hut-8-shares-slip-mild-q2-revenue-miss-ai-data-center-pipeline-grows; search for October-November lease news returned nothing.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-24 Hut 8 closed an undrawn $1.07B four-year senior secured revolver (SOFR+175bp, 12 banks led by JPMorgan with Citi, Goldman, Morgan Stanley) with a full letter-of-credit sublimit explicitly for 'site development collateral, such as interconnection deposits and obligations to utilities and equipment vendors'; a non-dilutive bank line that funds the next sites' power commitments, against an ATM-dilution overhang the press keeps citing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-06 $4.25B Beacon Point notes and 2026-04 $3.25B River Bend notes were project financings tied to signed leases; the stock's moves came from the leases, not the financing. Stock fell after this Sep 28 announcement with the AI-infra selloff.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for five weeks, so mostly priced; the residual is that the call can tie the LC capacity to named new sites (corroborating a ramp, signed positive per the financing question) and answer the CoreWeave-style debt worry with a parent-level investment-grade-style line. Minimum-liquidity covenant only from Q1 2027; no going-concern or covenant pressure.

findings.finding: Positioning is washed out into the print: HUT fell ~29-40% over the month to Oct 23 ($61.23) amid an October AI-data-center debt selloff (CoreWeave -15.5% on Oct 14), sits -51.7% off its 52w high with ~14.7% of shares short (18.15M, 2.5 DTC at Oct 15), and bounced +15% intraday on Nov 3 before the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent in the baseline; the Nov 2025 print came after a run-up and sold -12.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The +30.7 put skew says the option market is still paying for downside after a 30% fall; a mid-teens short base with 2.5 DTC can squeeze on any non-bad print. Sized small because the skew points the other way and the Nov 3 +15% bounce already spent some of the squeeze.
